decisions.reason: The existing message-444 MODIFY already removes the obsolete LED load and LED-control attributes from the switched 5V rail and narrows its contexts to the remaining sensor-power role.
The existing message-444 MODIFY already adds the SK6812 LEDs to the loads supplied by the complete standalone USB 3.3V rail.
Changing the selected LEDs' supply and data-drive arrangement does not change the LED board's count, selected part, package, mounting, or color channels.
The LED power change does not alter the sensor-board connector matrix, pinouts, or connector count.
The panel reset connector and EN-to-GND behavior are independent of the LED supply and data-level arrangement.
Moving the LEDs from 5V to 3.3V does not change the SPS30 SEL connection or its I2C operating mode.
The PIR connector requirement remains valid unchanged and is unrelated to the LED electrical interface.
The panel button and switch connectors, GPIO assignments, and mounting arrangement are unaffected by the LED supply change.
The capacitive-touch connectors, TTP223 devices, and GPIO assignments remain unchanged.
The decision redistributes an LED load between existing rails but does not change the requirement to monitor both 3.3V and 5V or the number of spare monitor channels.
Both 3.3V and 5V rails remain required, and the AXP2101 remains the normal-operation power source; only the LED's downstream rail assignment changes.
The source does not change DCDC1's 3.4V configuration, 2A rating, downstream 3.3V target, or Schottky-drop compensation requirement.
